report.title: Locator expected to be visible but was not
report.summary: The test expected a locator to be visible, but it was not. This is likely due to the test expecting a specific text that is not present on the page.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Go to the ParaBank website and log in as a registered user.
2. Navigate to the Open Account page.
3. Select 'CHECKING' as the account type and a funding account.
report.expected: The locator 'with a new checking account number' should be visible on the page.
report.actual: Locator expected to be visible, but was not (Actual value: None)
report.suspected_cause: The test is expecting a specific text that is not present on the page.
report.next_action: Review the test code and verify that the expected text is correct and present on the page.
